COST: 166

Driving is 86 minutes (22 for Dhunche, 64 for Gajuri). Penalties are 80 (one adult at Gajuri and three adults at Gosaikunda care home deferred). Rescuing the Gosaikunda group costs 160 minutes of driving to save 60 in penalties, so deferring them is cheaper. The Trishuli–Nilkantha road was excluded because of the fast floodwater.
